sim_to_real_framing.description: ACWA is treated as a sim-to-real transfer/OOD validation, not a primary benchmark.
sim_to_real_framing.interpretation: Physics-grounded augmentation trained on EPANET simulations should transfer to the ACWA real-world testbed because hydraulic signatures are governed by the same conservation laws, regardless of network scale or sensor technology.
sim_to_real_framing.note: Full sim-to-real evaluation requires training the primary model on EPANET data; see run_cross_network_eval.py
